name: dsm-firmenich
verdict: Nutrition, health and beauty group created by the 2022 DSM-Firmenich merger; parent DSM-Firmenich AG is dual-listed on Euronext Amsterdam and SIX Swiss Exchange, with asset managers (UBS 7.27%, Artisan Investments 5.04%, BlackRock 4.39%) the largest notified holders. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Listed parent (Euronext Amsterdam + SIX); per the Dutch AFM register of 3%+ disclosures, the largest notified holdings are UBS Group AG 7.27% (18 Sep 2026), Artisan Investments GP LLC 5.04% (19 Nov 2025) and BlackRock 4.39% (23 Sep 2026); Firmenich family members (Pometta, Jaeger-Firmenich, Genecand) notified stakes in 2023. No state or state fund holds 3% or more (Norges Bank last notified 2.99% in June 2025). No human-rights finding against dsm-firmenich found.
